title: ‘The decision was mine’: Antonio Conte confirms he is leaving Napoli
content:
Antonio Conte has announced he is leaving Napoli following their final game of the Serie A season on Sunday.

Speaking at a press conference alongside the club’s president Aurelio De Laurentiis, following Napoli’s final-day win over Udinese, the pair confirmed that the head coach would not continue in post next term.

Having taken charge in summer 2024, Conte claimed a fifth Italian league title in his maiden season in charge, having previously won three with Juventus and one with Inter Milan.

They struggled to reach the same heights this season, however, ultimately finishing as runners-up, 11 points shy of Inter.

Explaining his decision, Conte told the assembled media: “After Bologna, I sensed some situations I didn’t like, and even there, it takes guts to speak your mind. I’ve never been one for mediocre seasons, and I never will be. I was even prepared to step aside; certainly, some new signings didn’t gel with the existing squad, and some very difficult dynamics had developed that needed to be addressed.

“I was lucky enough to have a group I could be straight with, we sorted things out, telling each other that we had to pull together, and we set off again. I rang the chairman a month ago; I didn’t want to hear anything else and told him, ‘Given the friendship we share, I feel that my time here is coming to an end.’ The decision was mine.”

Conte has left on good terms with Napoli. Even though he has cited a lack of unity behind his decision to depart, his friendship with owner Aurelio De Laurentiis remains intact. De Laurentiis appeared beside Conte in a press conference announcing the decision. De Laurentiis has fallen out with coaches in the past. But not Conte.

Conte denied having an agreement to take charge of the Italian national team for a second time. The Italian Football Federation is still yet to elect a new president.

Conte has, largely, shown a different, more mellow side to himself at Napoli. He won the league despite the loan of Victor Osimhen to Galatasaray and sale of Khvicha Kvaratskelia 18 months ago. He tried to change style too, only for an unprecedented injury crisis to hurt Napoli’s title defence this season. He leaves with a record of two trophies. Napoli won the Super Coppa over the winter. Conte has not finished outside the top two in Italy since he became Juventus coach 15 years ago.
